title: LongDocURL Dataset Build and Evaluation Protocol

nodes.label:
Common Crawl PDF Archive
Over 200,000 raw candidate PDF documents
Unfiltered multi-domain web publication dump

Page Count & Language Filter
50 to 150 pages document length window
FastText English language identification

Content Diversity Type Scan
Requires rich mixed content elements
5 to 10 visual elements per page (tables, charts, formulas)

396 Gold Standard Documents
Diversified across finance, legal, science, government
Average 84.7 pages per document

Multi-Layer Document Parsing
Extract raw text stream, font attributes & bounding boxes
Segment pages into coherent visual reading blocks

Text-Type-BoundingBox Triples
Structured representation of visual text layout
Bounding box normalization [0, 1000] coordinates

Iterative Multi-Hop QA Generation
GPT-4o generates question-evidence-answer triples
Multi-page cross-referencing and spatial reasoning

3-Way Verification Gate
Evaluate answerability & visual grounding
Human & automated consensus on evidence bboxes

Ambiguous Candidate Rejection
Discard ungrounded or ambiguous QA pairs
Log failure reasons for pipeline auditing

2,325 Gold Benchmark QA Pairs
Single-page, multi-page, and cross-modal reasoning
Exact bounding box spatial grounding labels

Multi-Modal Document Prompting
Interleave high-resolution page images
Formulate open-ended QA & grounding queries

Multimodal LLM Inference
Evaluate frontier VLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini 1.5)
Generate natural language answers & predicted bboxes

Dual-Metric Evaluation & Reporting
Exact Match & F1 for textual answers
Intersection-over-Union (IoU >= 0.5) for spatial boxes
